checklist.item: No lookahead: semantic state strictly trailing; warmup respected; H4 from 16 aligned bars
checklist.evidence: jrv2/features.py: all windows trailing (r_k log(close[t]/close[t-k]); rv24 std over t-23..t; rv_pctile ranks rv24[t] against EXCLUSIVE past rv24[t-168:t]; dd_168/dist_low/range_pos/vol_z/clv_24 windows end at t; EMA/ADX recursive-causal); vector_at returns None for t<192 (warmup guard); rv_pctile loop starts at t=192. jrv2/data.py _bucket_resample: H4 bucket complete iff exactly span_bars=16 bars AND open offsets are exactly {0..15}x15m (aligned), partials fail-closed out of the regime series; census_check hard-fails vs freeze. Audit re-ran census: BTC 15m rows 35039, H1 complete 8759 / 0 interior gaps, H4 complete 2189 / 0 gaps, SPY 2943 sessions - all equal to freezes/data_identity_freeze.json. Prior fields of state t derive only from persisted state at t-1 (questionio.sequential_timeline / replay.run_replay: persisted_by_index[t-1] written after the persistence step at t-1). Mutation test present: tests_py::test_features::test_no_lookahead_mutation.

checklist.item: Forced-choice semantics: exactly 4 phase options, no UNKNOWN anywhere, 5th label -> SCHEMA_ERROR
checklist.evidence: freezes/question_contract.json phase.options == [ACCUMULATION, UPTREND, DISTRIBUTION, DOWNTREND] with explicit forced-choice law string; jrv2/__init__.py PHASES identical; adapter/src/contract.ts PHASES identical. Static test proves the BUILT criteria carry no UNKNOWN-equivalent (adapter/test/schema_matrix.test.ts 'no UNKNOWN option exists anywhere in the built criteria (static law)'). Runtime rejection both sides: Python validate_response_line rejects choice outside options -> SCHEMA_ERROR and additionally screens FORBIDDEN_PHASE_LABELS (TRANSITION_UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN/UNCLEAR/ABSTAIN) (tests_py::test_questionio::test_fifth_phase_label_is_schema_error); TS validateAnswers does the same (schema_matrix.test.ts fifth-label and TRANSITION_UNKNOWN-probability cases). Prompt carries explicit forced-choice instruction (prompt.ts).

checklist.item: Code-owned UNKNOWN: every trigger mapped, thresholds never lowered
checklist.evidence: jrv2/safety.py effective_from_response implements every trigger of freezes/safety_persistence_contract.json code_owned_unknown_triggers: response None -> no_response; status != OK -> status_* (provider/schema failure); missing state -> LOCAL_INVALID never sent (replay.py) / no_response; confidence < min_confidence -> low_confidence; top1-top2 margin < min_margin -> low_margin; hierarchy contradiction -> evaluate_consistency reasons; persistence confirmation -> step() machine. Thresholds come only from fz.persistence_params() (frozen 0.50/0.20/2/6/3); auditor probed boundaries: conf == 0.50 passes, 0.4999 -> UNKNOWN; margin 0.1999 -> UNKNOWN. No code path lowers them (no_forced_trades_law).

checklist.item: Consistency matrix: implementation == AMENDED frozen law text (RANGE lineage + residual direction)
checklist.evidence: Auditor encoded the freeze text (freezes/question_contract.json consistency_law, trial-1) as an INDEPENDENT truth table and compared against safety.evaluate_consistency over all 2 structures x 3 directions x 4 phases x 4 priors (UP/DOWN/NEUTRAL/none) = 96 combos (superset of the mandated 72): ZERO mismatches. Threshold gates re-verified (see C). tests_py::test_safety::test_full_consistency_matrix_72_combos and per-contradiction-pattern tests agree. Note: the amended law deliberately deviates from PLAN section 1.4's original wording (plan said RANGE+UP/DOWN -> contradiction); the deviation is the disclosed design trial 1 within the plan's own preregistered revision budget (plan section 4) - see finding F1 and observation O3.

checklist.item: Cross-language digest: producer-digest echo law + prompt-digest-in-cache-key law
checklist.evidence: Producer law: input_digest = sha256(canonical_json(state_payload) || requested_model) computed ONLY in Python (freezes.py canonical_json single authority; contract.ts echoes verbatim, never recomputes - documented and enforced). Auditor recomputed the producer digest for ALL 78 cached canary requests: 78/78 match; response echo matches 78/78; random sample of 10 re-verified on BOTH sides (Python hashlib vs TS computeInputDigest via node): 10/10 equal. Golden tests pin the known Python-vs-JS float-formatting divergence (exponent notation) proving why echo is law (adapter/test/digest_golden.test.ts; tests_py::test_questionio::test_golden_digest_vectors_pinned). Cache-key law: key = sha256(model||state_id||input_digest||prompt_digest); auditor recomputed keys from adapter/src/contract.ts computeCacheKey with the live prompt digest (a5ae16443062be30...): trial-1 entries match exactly (e.g. 09df255b92d5e1e1); trial-0 entries match only with the pre-amendment digest - see finding F1.

checklist.item: Sequential prior-state replay: strict order, prior from persisted state after merge, one call per state, cache-first resume, hard fail
checklist.evidence: jrv2/replay.py run_replay: strict ascending t over [warmup, T); prior fields = persisted_by_index[t-1], written only AFTER effective label merged and step() advanced; exactly ONE adapter subprocess per state with a single-line request file and exactly-1-response-line enforcement (ReplayError otherwise); adapter exit != 0 -> ReplayError (no silent partial bulk); cache-first: decisions store consulted before any call, cached lines RE-VALIDATED against the freshly recomputed digest (stale -> incident), DecisionStore.append is append-only and refuses state_id rewrites; LOCAL_INVALID states never sent. tests_py::test_replay::test_replay_resume_from_cache_is_deterministic.

checklist.item: Call/cost projection from MEASURED usage for BTC_H1 8567 + BTC_H4 1997 + SPY_D1 2751

Trial-1 per-call: input mean 4069.7 (min 4032, max 4080), output mean 130.5 (129-133); trial-0 per-call: 4024.7 / 130.5 - both trials agree within ~1.1%. Projection at trial-1 measured means: BTC_H1 8,567 calls = 34.87M in / 1.12M out; BTC_H4 1,997 = 8.13M in / 0.26M out; SPY_D1 2,751 = 11.20M in / 0.36M out; TOTAL 13,315 calls = 54.19M input / 1.74M output tokens (approx; per-call variance small). Latency measured mean 1076 ms/call -> approx 4.0 h sequential wall clock for 13,315 calls (single heavy worker). Both design trials consumed 315,684 in / 10,182 out tokens total. Fold-contract cell sizes match the projection (8567/1997/2751, warmup 192, 4 folds each).

findings.finding: F1: The trial-1 disclosure clause 'no prompt change' is inaccurate. The consistency_law text is embedded verbatim in the prompt (adapter/src/prompt.ts QUESTION_INSTRUCTIONS.consistency_law from freeze_digests.ts) and hashed into the prompt digest; the amendment therefore changed the prompt identity. Hard evidence: trial-0 and trial-1 cache entries for identical requests share the same request_sha256 (e.g. 49a7da22495a...) but have DIFFERENT cache keys; trial-1 keys recompute exactly with the current prompt digest a5ae16443062be30..., trial-0 keys do not. No law is broken - the change IS the disclosed revision 1 of 2, pre-historical, and the prompt-freeze law only engages after the first historical preview call - but the STOP-1 report must present the trial-1 change as a prompt-identity change (which it is), not as 'no prompt change'.

F2: Trial-0's aggregated canary result JSON was overwritten by trial-1 at the same path (runtime/live/canary_synthetic_result.json); no separate trial-0 result artifact exists. Trial-0 raw responses ARE preserved (39 cache entries stored_at 08:32-33Z + first 39 lines of canary_adapter_summaries.jsonl) so the trial is fully reconstructable, but the preservation claim holds at raw-response level only.

F3/O4: The frozen state_id law sha256('JRV2'||asset||data_sha||bar_ts)[:16] has no regime-clock dimension: all 2,189 BTC H4 bucket closes coincide with BTC H1 bar closes, so H1 and H4 states at the same timestamp share a state_id while carrying different content. No contamination path exists today (per-cell decisions files; adapter cache key includes the input_digest of the state content), but any future tool that indexes decisions by state_id ACROSS cells would silently conflate H1/H4. Flag for A7-2: per-cell decision stores must stay segregated.

F4/O3: PLAN section 1.4's original consistency-law wording (RANGE+UP/DOWN -> contradiction) no longer matches the operative amended freeze (RANGE lineage residual-direction reading, sanctioned as preregistered design trial 1). Freeze text, safety.py, embedded adapter law and both test suites agree with each other; only the plan document itself was not annotated. Documentation-level inconsistency; the freeze remains the operative contract under the plan's own section 4 revision law.
